verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to automate, customize, and execute software development workflows inside the repository, backed by CI/CD positioning. Push protection is a concrete example of an event-triggered rule, automatically blocking a push when it detects an active secret. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-trigger syntax (e.g. on push/PR/issue events) or webhooks, and independent hands-on corroboration of rule-based automation.
